messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Your prescriber makes this change, not you.
Triplet: ["Metoprolol", "dose adjustment responsibility", "prescriber"]

The relation 'dose adjustment responsibility' in the triplet is defined as 'The entity specified by the object is responsible for making changes to the dose of the subject drug.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has dose adjustment instruction': The subject drug may require changes in dosage based on the condition or factor specified in the object entity.
B. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
C. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the effect specified by the object entity.
D. 'has dose limitation': The subject drug has a restriction on the dose specified by the object entity.
E. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
